pages.text: The $(item)Supreme Table$() is an $(l)81x81$() crafting grid — 6561 cells of possible recipe space. Pan with $(thing)middle-mouse drag$(), zoom with $(thing)scroll wheel$(). Recipes are shape-and-size-strict: place ingredients in a tight bounding box anywhere on the canvas and the result appears as long as the pattern matches.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Drop ingredients into any cells. $(br2)Use EMI or JEI's $(l)+$() button to auto-fill — partial fills are supported, so big recipes can be completed across multiple top-up clicks.
